description: List a page of visible, non-archived saved segments with subtype, status, and record counts. Use when the user asks what segments they have; filter by subtype or pass a limit of 1–100. For one complete definition, call get_segment with its segment_id. Requires 'discovery' scope.

compact.description: Return small summaries by default. Set false to include saved filter_groups on filter segments; get_segment retrieves one complete definition.

include_archived.description: Include archived objects so they can be found and restored

limit.description: Maximum number of segments to return (default 10; maximum 100)

subtype.description: Optional: filter results to a specific segment subtype; custom is materialized membership published by the data team.

name: list_segments

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions

total.description: Number of segments on this page

title: List Segments
